report_rules: Please provide detailed reports with reproducible steps. If the report is not detailed enough to reproduce the issue, the issue will not be eligible for a reward.
Submit one vulnerability per report unless you need to chain vulnerabilities to provide impact.
Please, keep report brief and concise. 300-400 words per report is a good limit.
